src/base.css.name: Colors, fonts and layout
src/base.css.description: Sets the look of every screen: the colors in light and dark mode, the fonts, the stage (the 3D cube or a flat side), grids, buttons and small-phone sizes.

src/extra.css.name: Cube picker, header tools, flat turns and camera look
src/extra.css.description: Styles the cube choice, the header's language switch and theme toggle, the credits line, the 3x3 grids, the thinking spinner and the camera sheet, and the flat view of a turn: the side, its sliding layer, the arrow and the After picture.

src/page.template.html.name: Page skeleton
src/page.template.html.description: The empty page the pieces are poured into: the title, icon and fonts, the header, the 3D stage and the panel.
